SessionStart.command: if [ -z "${SPAWN_SUBAGENT_META:-}" ]; then cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; printf '%s\n' '{}'; else "${SPAWN_SUBAGENT_BUN:-bun}" "${SPAWN_SUBAGENT_BIN:-$HOME/.local/bin/spawn-subagent}" _agy-hook session-start; fi

Stop.command: if [ -z "${SPAWN_SUBAGENT_META:-}" ]; then cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; printf '%s\n' '{}'; else "${SPAWN_SUBAGENT_BUN:-bun}" "${SPAWN_SUBAGENT_BIN:-$HOME/.local/bin/spawn-subagent}" _agy-hook stop; fi
